title: Anyone have any good experience using an AI trading platform?
author: Elegant-Run-5946
selftext:
I'm not good enough with coding or prompts to make my own trading bot and was wondering if anyone has used an AI trading platform that actually works?

There are tons of platforms out there but not sure what people's experiences are using them.

  
Would appreciate it if anyone has had a good experience and actually made money on any of them.

comments.author: wallstreet-b
comments.body: Try to code your strategy with chatgpt or claude and run it in prorealtime on an IG account. If you dont yet have a strategy and dont know what you want to trade, find your style by doing simulator trades in [wallstreet-billionaire.com](http://wallstreet-billionaire.com) (free). If you found what works for you, transfer the manual strategy into code.

comments.author: CryptographerBig7624
comments.body:
most of them are just fancy wrappers around basic indicators with 'AI' slapped on for marketing. the real question is what you mean by works - like does it execute trades or does it actually help you not lose money  
  
if youre looking at something ask what the AI actually does. if they cant explain it in plain terms or they promise returns its probably garbage. the good ones should be able to show you why they blocked a trade not just that they took one  
  
also worth knowing most of these only work on one exchange so check if its one you can actually use in your country before you waste time

replies.author: Elegant-Run-5946
replies.body: Appreciate the help. I'm looking for anything that can help me not lose money. I've heard people saying that you should only ask AI for strategies and use a rule based bot to do the actual trading. Heard AI can get stuck and not make any decisions at all.

replies.author: TastyTrading
replies.body: ThetaPal gives consulting advice on AI agentic bots. Super helpful folks

comments.author: AdministrativeBug554
comments.body: If you want to create quant models using ML and then trade those stocks you could try quant-builder. It's not a trading bot. You build your quant models(ai can help), backtest and then when you deploy you get stocks ranked by confidence everyday and trade those with automated exits. Built more for swing trading but works for day trading (3-15 day holding periods).

replies.author: Elegant-Run-5946
replies.body: Never heard of that one. Is it a paid service? Have you had a good experience using it?

comments.author: Routine_Bat6675
comments.body: No. I built trading bot that based on defined strategy using [Sentimentick](https://www.sentimentick.com) data and IBKR gateway. For me it works very good.

replies.author: Elegant-Run-5946
replies.body: When you say it works very good, do you mean you were able to make profits using your trading bot?

comments.author: d3xinho
comments.body:
You can check out Cod3x, its pretty easy to use and been around for some time now, so its battle tested. 

Basic templates are fine, but you can "enhance" them by talking to it. Here's a guy substacking about it:
 https://d4much.substack.com/p/my-trading-bot-has-had-14-brains

Can choose your own llm model, etc...

comments.author: capybarachinchilla
comments.body: It's actually hit or miss when it comes to finding the right trading tool. Honestly, not everything will fit your style or preferences. Before I settled on the one I'm using now, I tried a bunch of different tools you name it. So far, this one's been the best fit for me. I can't say it'll work for everyone, but out of everything I've tried it's the one that has met my expectations.

comments.author: effi6
comments.body: I found algobars and it’s honestly the best thing ever for automating trading systems. It runs even if you’re not signed in so no need for a VPS. Highly recommend. Best thing ever.

comments.author: 3BBBUrf

Met een winst van 80 en verlies van 20% ben ik verder tevreden. Daarnaast heb ik geleerd dat soms niet traden ook geld oplevert. Blijf weg van Coins en Forex en gebruik geen hefboom stratdgie hoe aantrekkelijk ook.

comments.author: Patient-Bumblebee
comments.body:
Everstrike. Its pay as you go. No subscription. You pay only per AI evaluation. There is a free tier which includes like $0.5 in daily credits (enough for running 1 basic strategy).

I wouldnt pay money for anything unless I had already verified that it worked. Too many vibecoded scams or useless apps out there.

I wouldnt pay money for anything unless I had verified that it already worked. Too many vibecoded scams and useless apps out there.

comments.author: Cute-Opposite4751
comments.body:
Honest answer... i’d be careful with any platform claiming its AI “actually works” or can consistently make money for you. Most of them are black boxes, and the backtests usually look way better than the live results once you factor in slippage, fees and changing market conditions.

I’d start by testing any strategy with paper trades for a few months and track drawdown, consistency and how it performs across different market conditions. Something like UpsideOnly is really useful if you want to avoid risking your money and because you submit paper trades that are later analyzed by their ai models, and if your insights help male grest trades, you get rewarded. But this is not a bot that blindly trades your account. Honestly, if a platform can’t clearly explain what the AI does, what the risks are and show realistic live results, I’d stay away.
